queries.name: event-base
queries.subject: Project shared event fields before combining run-owned records.
queries.objective: Provide the narrow retained event evidence needed for inspection and run import-coverage analysis.
queries.acceptance: The result unions retained audit, domain, tool, and issue records with their available run identity; an empty or unavailable preview cannot establish zero source activity or complete import coverage.

queries.name: audit-event-runs
queries.subject: Count imported audit records per run before combining event sources.
queries.objective: Bound audit evidence for run import-coverage analysis.
queries.acceptance: Count only retained audit records with event identity by run attempt; missing evidence does not establish zero activity.

queries.name: domain-event-runs
queries.subject: Count imported domain records per run before combining event sources.
queries.objective: Bound domain evidence for run import-coverage analysis.
queries.acceptance: Count only retained domain records with event identity by run attempt; missing evidence does not establish zero activity.

queries.name: tool-event-runs
queries.subject: Sum original imported Tool event counts per run from compact usage facts.
queries.objective: Bound tool evidence for run import-coverage analysis.
queries.acceptance: Sum original retained event counts, not aggregate rows, by winning Run attempt; missing evidence does not establish zero activity.

queries.name: issue-event-runs
queries.subject: Count imported issue records per run before combining event sources.
queries.objective: Bound issue evidence for run import-coverage analysis.
queries.acceptance: Count only retained issue records with event identity by run attempt; missing evidence does not establish zero activity.

queries.name: event-runs
queries.subject: Identify each workflow run that has one or more imported run-owned records.
queries.objective: Identify run attempts with retained imported records so their presence can be compared with observed runs.
queries.acceptance: One row per organization, repository, workflow, run, and attempt contains events, the count of matching retained records; no row in an available result does not prove that no event was produced.
queries.description: Distinct workflow runs represented by imported domain, tool, audit, or issue records.

queries.name: run-import-status
queries.subject: Identify observed runs that have one or more imported run-owned records.
queries.objective: Compare observed run attempts with retained run-owned event evidence to locate import-coverage gaps for investigation.
queries.acceptance: Keep each observed run and its run-attempt identity; imported-event-count is zero and imported is false without a matching retained event, but missing events alone do not establish an ingestion failure.
queries.description: Observed runs enriched with imported-record status.

queries.name: workflow-run-totals
queries.subject: Summarize observed run counts and imported runs by declared workflow.
queries.objective: Compare observed run attempts, conclusions, and imported-record coverage for each workflow.
queries.acceptance: Group by organization, repository, and workflow; report distinct run-attempt totals, successful and failed conclusion counts, and imported-run totals only from retained evidence. Missing run records cannot establish zero execution.
queries.description: Observed run and imported-run totals for each declared workflow.

queries.name: workflow-aic-totals
queries.subject: Summarize observed AI Credit usage by declared workflow.
queries.objective: Expose retained AI Credit consumption per workflow for bounded cost review alongside observed execution.
queries.acceptance: Return the sum of recorded aic-total by organization, repository, and workflow; missing usage or runs is not evidence of zero actual cost.
queries.description: Observed AI Credit totals for each declared workflow.

queries.name: mcp-tool-workflow-totals
queries.subject: Summarize observed MCP calls by tool and workflow before the tool inventory is materialized.
queries.objective: Keep MCP inventory intermediates bounded without dropping calls or changing byte totals.
queries.acceptance: Count retained observation identities and sum request and response bytes per server, tool, and workflow; retain safe-output-server classification for downstream exclusion.

queries.name: mcp-tool-calls
queries.subject: Prepare MCP tool calls for aggregation with safe-output-server calls identified for downstream exclusion.
queries.objective: Identify retained MCP call labels and safe-output-server classification for downstream tool-use investigation.
queries.acceptance: Preserve each retained call with its workflow key and tool label and mark safe-output-server calls explicitly; downstream exclusion must not be mistaken for absence of those calls or complete tool telemetry.
queries.description: Observed MCP tool calls labeled with whether they belong to the internal safe outputs server.
